wiki.title: Jimmy Pesto's Pizzeria
wiki.body:
The flashy Italian restaurant directly across Ocean Avenue from Bob's Burgers, run by Bob's self-appointed arch-rival **Jimmy Pesto**.

## Notes
- Home turf of Jimmy Jr., Andy, and Ollie Pesto
- The Bob-versus-Jimmy feud drives episodes from the burger cook-off to the table-scoring wars
- Known more for gimmicks and karaoke nights than for the actual food

wiki.title: Menu Board
wiki.body:
A big glossy menu board — everything has a theme name and nothing is as good as it sounds.

Unlike the hand-chalked **Burger of the Day** board across the street, Jimmy's menu never changes. Style over substance is kind of the whole point.

## Trivia
- Jimmy Pesto's serves 'authentic' Italian despite Jimmy being about as Italian as a mall food court
- The dining room doubles as a karaoke stage after hours
